message_headers.name: Nats-Msg-Id
message_headers.semantics: Stable application message ID used for JetStream publish deduplication and redelivery correlation.

message_headers.name: Rjs-Contract-Version
message_headers.semantics: Native SDK contract version; this document requires v1alpha1.

message_headers.name: Rjs-Queue
message_headers.semantics: Logical Queue name after exchange or direct-target resolution.

message_headers.name: Rjs-Policy-Revision
message_headers.semantics: Queue plan revision used to resolve the publish target.

message_headers.name: Rjs-Priority
message_headers.semantics: Canonical base-10 priority with no sign or leading zeroes; omitted for non-priority Queues.

scheduler.guarantee: After each high-priority burst, probe lower non-empty levels from highest to lowest before starting another burst.

delivery.backpressure: Bound outstanding fetches and bytes; do not issue an unbounded pull.
